description: Starts one run of a recurring Open Design job: a job file at .open-design/jobs/<id>.job.md (YAML frontmatter naming the recipe, period, timezone, mode, target and outputs, then the brief). Call it first whenever a prompt says "Run the Open Design job <path>" (usually a scheduled task), or for the supervised first run after writing a job. It validates the job (listing every problem by field), works out the period key in the job's timezone (2026-10-21, 2026-W43 or 2026-10), and returns skip with a reason when this period already has a completed run and the sources haven't changed: then report that in one line and change nothing. Otherwise it records a started run and returns its runId, the target entry's state (exists, staleSources, the preview link), the run's capabilities (browser, cloud) and the ordered steps to follow, ending with finish_open_design_job_run. In a cloud session it first asks you to check out the job's state branch. Runs stay private: never publish publicly or post to social networks from a job run.

jobPath.description: Workspace-relative path of the job file, e.g. ".open-design/jobs/weekly-kpis.job.md".

runNow.description: Rebuild even though this period already has a completed run (the person asked for a fresh run). Don't set it from a scheduled prompt.

name: start_open_design_job_run
